en.home.hero_description: Professional restoration, refinishing, polishing, repair and maintenance for natural stone and concrete surfaces throughout Los Angeles County.
en.home.about_title: We were created to revive surfaces others
en.home.about_description: Resurfacing Solutions was born from a clear idea: provide a professional way to restore, renew, and preserve surfaces without replacing them entirely. Through experience, attention to detail, and respect for every space, we transform natural stone and concrete to recover their original beauty, performance, and value.
en.services.label: Featured Services
en.services.title: Expertise applied to
en.services.description: We never apply the same process to every material. Each service is tailored to the surface, its current condition, and the finish you want, delivering precise and lasting restoration designed for each individual space.
en.services.restoration_text: We restore shine, consistency, and service life to natural stone and concrete surfaces with precision and proven expertise.
en.services.polishing_text: We remove dullness, marks, and minor imperfections to achieve a smoother, more consistent surface with the right level of shine.
en.services.cleaning_text: We remove dirt, residue, and contaminants, then apply professional sealers that protect the surface and extend its service life.
en.services.repair_text: We repair cracks, damaged edges, chips, and deteriorated joints to restore the surface's integrity, continuity, and appearance.
en.services.concrete_text: We refine the surface to create a consistent, durable, bright finish that is easy to maintain.
en.services.maintenance_text: We design preventive plans that preserve the finish, reduce wear, and keep every surface in optimal condition.

en.faq.label: Frequently Asked Questions
en.faq.title: Before we begin,
en.faq.q1: What types of surfaces do you restore?
en.faq.a1: We work with marble, travertine, terrazzo, natural stone, and concrete. Before recommending a treatment, we assess the material, finish, and level of wear.
en.faq.q2: Does the entire surface need to be replaced?
en.faq.a2: In many cases, no. Professional polishing, repair, sealing, or refinishing can recover the surface appearance and performance without complete replacement.
en.faq.q3: How do you prepare an estimate?
en.faq.a3: We begin with photos and a description of the area. When needed, we perform an assessment to confirm dimensions, damage, material, and desired finish before presenting the proposal.
en.faq.q4: How long can the process take?
en.faq.a4: Timing depends on the size, material, and treatment required. Smaller projects may be completed within a few days, and we provide a clear timeline before work begins.
en.faq.q5: How do you protect the space during the work?
en.faq.a5: We isolate the work area, protect nearby surfaces, and maintain an organized process. Our goal is to work precisely while minimizing dust, debris, and disruption.
en.faq.q6: Is your work insured or guaranteed?
en.faq.a6: Yes. Every project includes a workmanship guarantee. If something does not meet the agreed expectations, we review and correct it within the established warranty period.

en.about.history_text: At Resurfacing Solutions, we believe a worn surface does not always need to be replaced. Our work begins by understanding the material, assessing its condition, and applying the right process to recover its appearance, strength, and value.

en.about.intro_text: We began with a purpose: to recover surfaces that still hold lasting value. Our experience, attention to detail, and knowledge of every material allow us to create precise solutions for homes, businesses, and properties throughout Los Angeles County.
en.about.process_text_1: No two surfaces experience the same wear or respond in exactly the same way. Before beginning any work, we assess the material, its condition, how the space is used, and the finish you want to recover.
en.about.process_text_2: From that assessment, we define a specific process to restore, protect, and extend its service life—no generic solutions and no one-size-fits-all treatments.

es.services.description: No aplicamos el mismo proceso a todos los materiales. Cada servicio se adapta al tipo de superficie, su estado actual y el acabado que deseas, garantizando una restauración precisa, duradera y hecha a la medida de cada espacio.

es.services.cleaning_text: Eliminamos suciedad, residuos y contaminantes, y aplicamos selladores profesionales que protegen y prolongan la vida útil.
es.services.repair: Reparación de grietas, astillas y juntas

es.services.maintenance_text: Diseñamos planes preventivos que conservan el acabado, reducen el desgaste y mantienen cada superficie en óptimas condiciones.

es.faq.title: Antes de comenzar,
es.faq.a1: Trabajamos con mármol, travertino, terrazo, piedra natural y concreto. Antes de recomendar un tratamiento, evaluamos el material, el acabado y el nivel de desgaste.
es.faq.a2: En muchos casos no. El pulido, la reparación, el sellado o el reacondicionamiento profesional pueden recuperar su apariencia y desempeño sin reemplazarla por completo.
es.faq.a3: Comenzamos con fotografías y una descripción del área. Cuando es necesario, realizamos una evaluación para confirmar dimensiones, daños, material y acabado deseado.
es.faq.a4: El tiempo depende del tamaño, el material y el tratamiento requerido. Los proyectos pequeños pueden completarse en pocos días y siempre definimos el cronograma antes de comenzar.
es.faq.q5: ¿Cómo protegen el espacio durante el trabajo?
es.faq.a5: Aislamos el área de trabajo, protegemos las superficies cercanas y mantenemos un proceso organizado para minimizar polvo, residuos e interrupciones.
es.faq.a6: Sí. Cada proyecto incluye garantía de mano de obra. Si algo no cumple lo acordado, lo revisamos y corregimos dentro del período establecido.
